notes: SHARED PATTERN across all 14 classes: every function is Ghidra-mislabeled 'GetManagers' because it references the class-name string used by the CInfoManager<T> singleton registry (FUN_11679e10 = registry lookup by name; FUN_102500e0/FUN_100d83d0 = StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager>::GetSingletonName). None of these are true DebugFormat printers or TLV readers, so field offsets are INFERRED from consumer control-flow, not from a labeled struct writer; confidence is capped accordingly. Two singleton-accessor shapes recur: (a) signature (dummy, "CXxxInfo", 0) returning the manager pointer = GetManager(); (b) signature (int flag) returning *DAT_xxx when flag==0 = GetManagerRaw()/instance ptr. Manager object layout used everywhere: vtable+0x28 = GetCount(); fields [5]/[6] (i.e. +0x14/+0x18) = begin/end of a contiguous vector<T*> so GetByIndex(i) = *(mgr[5]+i*4); the id-keyed hash form uses +0x20=bucket array, +0x24=capacity, +0x28=divisor(bucket size), +0x30=minKey so GetById(id): k=id-min; bucket=buckets[k/divisor]; elem=bucket[k%divisor]. The lazy-init blocks writing PTR_FUN_* + _DAT_11de9ae0.. are static singleton construction and carry no game-data fields. TLV cross-ref: TlvSuitSkillGroups L1 caller sub_115721D0 sits right beside CEquipSuitSkillGroupInfo builder 0x11572a90 (genuine match). TlvCatCuisineData/State are PLAYER runtime cuisine state (tCatTime/vCatSeq/iOpen/tOpenTime/iTools), NOT the static CCatCuisineInfo config table — flagged as discrepancy, do not map fields across.

classes.purpose: Equipment forge/'found' quality-roll table: each record is a quality tier with a selection weight. The core method does a weighted RNG roll to pick a quality tier, then selects a result item from CEquipFoundInfo filtered by that quality and the equipment level range.

methods.purpose: CInfoManager<CEquipFoundQualityInfo> singleton accessor (form a).
Raw manager instance pointer when flag==0 (form b).

Weighted RNG result roller. Pass 1 sums all records' weight (record+0x14) into total. Draws r = FUN_100ee450()*_DAT_11de98f0 (uniform 0..1). Pass 2 accumulates weight until running > r*total to pick a quality tier (qualityId = record+0x10). Then scans CEquipFoundInfo for records with field+0x14==qualityId and level in [+0x18,+0x1c] around param1, collects their result item id (+0x10) and returns one chosen by a second uniform draw.
